build_vocabulary_from_tokens: build a Vocabulary object from a list of token strings with special token configuration
build_vocab_with_builder: build a Vocabulary using VocabBuilder by adding tokens and calling make_vocab
pad_nested_lists: pad nested lists of variable length with a pad token to uniform shape
pad_and_tensorize_batch: pad a batch of sequences and convert to a PyTorch tensor
shard_rows_for_distributed: shard rows for distributed training by selecting every nth example for a given rank
